acceptance: The whole-corpus agreement guard runs in required CI on develop and fails when the two validators are made to differ
On published-results, a pull request that edits a vendored rule file is rejected by the guard list (tested with a throwaway pull request, then closed)
The drift check fails when the registry gains a scale that the data file lacks
published-results validates the current corpus with the new validator
context: Step of the corpus rule remediation plan (crr-00-corpus-rule-remediation-plan). Plan written 2026-11-22 and reviewed twice by an independent adversarial reviewer; counts marked (R) were measured by that reviewer and must be re-measured, not trusted. Owner decisions were given by choice dialog on 2026-11-22 and are quoted in crr-00.
description:
## Problem
published-results vendors a cut-down validator that cannot import the scale registry and falls back to the stamp (T1, T3). Its CI runs validators from the base commit, so validator changes must merge there before any result that depends on them.

## Change
- Generate a stdlib-only data file of standard scales and stream minima from the registry and tpc_spec.py; CI on develop fails when it drifts.
- Vendor the rule module, the score function and the data file. Add them to the path lists in sync-results-data-to-published.yml and to the "reject validator changes" list in validate-submission.yml on published-results.
- Guard: run the mirror validator and the develop validator over the whole corpus and require identical outcomes.
- Amend the slim-branch ADR's file list.

## Decision gates
- Order is fixed: validator mirror pull request merges on published-results before any pull request that adds results depending on the rule.
- If the mirror's CI cannot run the new files with the standard library only, stop and report; do not add a dependency to the mirror.

## Guardrails (apply to every item of this plan)
- Fix the root cause for every platform and benchmark. No rule, exception, label or test may name a platform or a version matrix. Only the pvm-p* items may name Polars, and only to run and stage that run's files.
- Never edit a stored result file to make it pass. Outcomes change only through the rule.
- Any change to the outcome of a stored result must show in the committed outcome snapshot diff in the same pull request and be explained in its body.
- No new stored class value. No reader may decide anything from benchmark.compliance_class, conformance_class or summary.tpc_metrics.suppressed.
- Paths, line numbers and counts in this plan were read on 2026-11-22 at develop 93f3360. Re-read before editing; report drift, do not guess.
- AGENTS.md applies: linked worktree, one pull request per item, close at the merged pull request, heavy work only through make heavy-run, no live cloud run without owner approval in that task.
- At a decision gate, follow the recorded default. If its stop condition is met, stop and report to the owner. Never substitute a different owner decision.
- Read crr-00-corpus-rule-remediation-plan first: it holds the owner decisions, the rule table and the fault types (T1 to T5).
